meta.title: Plans | Lumex Template
meta.description: Three flexible ways to build with Snow Holdings: Plan & Save, Build in Phases, and Start & Build Now.

layout.title:
One Vision.
Three Ways to Build
layout.description: Whether you are saving toward a future home, building step by step, or ready to break ground today, there is a plan that fits where you are now. Each plan is explained in detail below.

layout.title: Which Plan Fits You?
layout.description: Choose a plan to see who it is for, what is included and how it works. All plans are launching soon, so talk to us to register your interest.

plans.label: Plan & Save
plans.summary: Many great projects start years before the first block is laid. Plan & Save is for you if you have a dream home, rental units or a commercial space in mind, but are not ready to build yet.

benefits.title: A realistic plan:
benefits.description: A house plan and project idea shaped around your needs and your land.

benefits.title: A clear cost picture:
benefits.description: A preliminary estimate so you know what your project will take.

benefits.title: A target to work toward:
benefits.description: A defined goal and a simple way to track your progress toward it.

features.title: Start with an idea or existing plan
features.description: Bring a sketch, a picture of a house you like, or plans you already have. Every project starts from where you are.

features.title: Initial project consultation
features.description: We sit down with you to understand your goals, your land and your budget, and explain the options available to you.

features.title: House planning & design support
features.description: Our team helps you shape your idea into a practical, buildable house plan that fits your needs and your plot.

features.title: Preliminary cost estimation
features.description: You get an early estimate of what your project is likely to cost, so you know what you are working toward.

features.title: Set your construction target
features.description: Together we set a clear target for your project, what you want to build and the amount needed to get there.

features.title: Save toward construction or materials
features.description: Set money aside step by step toward your construction, or toward the materials you will need to build.

features.title: Track progress toward your goal
features.description: Stay on top of how close you are to your target, so you always know when you are ready to start.

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.description: Tell us what you want to build, whether it is a rough idea or a complete plan.

steps.title: Plan & estimate
steps.description: We help with the house plan and give you a preliminary cost estimate.

steps.title: Set your target
steps.description: We agree on a clear construction target based on your plan and estimate.

steps.title: Save & track
steps.description: You save toward construction or materials and follow your progress.

steps.title: Ready to build
steps.description: When you reach your target, you move on to building with a plan already in place.

plans.label: Build in Phases
plans.summary: Not every project needs to be built all at once. Build in Phases lets you complete your house or building one stage at a time, at a pace that suits you.

benefits.title: A phased project plan:
benefits.description: A clear breakdown of every phase and its budget.

benefits.title: Control over your pace:
benefits.description: Build as your budget allows, without compromising on quality.

benefits.title: Payments tied to progress:
benefits.description: You only pay for each stage as it is completed.

features.title: Use your own plans or design with us
features.description: Build from plans you already have, or let our team design the project with you.

features.title: Project budget & phase planning
features.description: We break your project into clear phases and set a budget for each one, so you always know what comes next.

features.title: Foundation & substructure
features.description: Setting out, excavation and a strong foundation, the base everything else is built on.

features.title: Walling & structural works
features.description: Walls, columns, beams and slabs that give your building its shape and strength.

features.title: Roofing
features.description: Roof structure and covering that protect your building and let the next phase begin.

features.title: Finishing & installations
features.description: Plastering, floors, doors, windows, fittings and installations that make the building ready to use.

features.title: Pay and build by agreed milestones
features.description: You pay as each agreed stage is completed, so progress and payments always move together.

steps.title: Plan the full project
steps.description: We start from your plans, or design with you, and look at the project as a whole.

steps.title: Split into phases
steps.description: The project is divided into phases, each with its own budget and milestone.

steps.title: Build phase by phase
steps.description: We build each phase, from the foundation through walling, roofing and finishing.

steps.title: Pay by milestone
steps.description: Each phase is paid for as its agreed milestone is reached.

steps.title: Handover
steps.description: Once the final phase is complete, your finished building is handed over to you.

plans.label: Start & Build Now
plans.summary: You have your approved plans and you are ready to begin. Start & Build Now takes your project from plans to a finished building with one team handling it from start to end.

benefits.title: One team, start to finish:
benefits.description: Planning, materials, construction and supervision handled by one team.

benefits.title: A clear budget up front:
benefits.description: A detailed cost estimate before construction begins.

benefits.title: A finished building:
benefits.description: Your project completed and handed over, ready to use.

features.title: Start with your own approved plans
features.description: Bring your approved plans and we take it from there.

features.title: Planning & project consultation
features.description: We go through your plans, goals and timeline, and agree how the project will run.

features.title: Site assessment & preparation
features.description: We assess your site and get it ready for construction.

features.title: Budgeting & cost estimation
features.description: A detailed budget and cost estimate, so you know what the project will cost before work starts.

features.title: Materials planning & procurement
features.description: We plan what materials are needed, and when, and source them for your project.

features.title: Full construction execution
features.description: Our team carries out the complete construction, from the foundation to the finishing.

features.title: Project supervision & coordination
features.description: We supervise the work on site and coordinate every trade, keeping the project on track.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We review your approved plans and agree on the scope and timeline.

steps.title: Site & budget
steps.description: We assess your site and prepare a detailed budget and cost estimate.

steps.title: Materials
steps.description: We plan and procure the materials your project needs.

steps.title: Construction
steps.description: We carry out the full construction under close supervision.

steps.title: Handover
steps.description: We complete final checks and hand over your finished building.
